events.title: ‘Freak the Mighty’ Presented by Seattle Rep
events.loc: Bagley Wright Theater , 155 Mercer St., Seattle
events.desc: Have your kids read “Freak the Mighty” yet? The coming-of-age story about two unlikely friends is brought to life in this heartfelt musical. It’s a powerful way to experience the story, while prompting conversations afterward about friendship and belonging.

events.title: The Royal Duck Bounce Park
events.desc: Giant inflatable ducks have taken over! Touted as the world’s largest and tallest bounce house, this touring inflatable experience is in town for a limited time. Let the kids jump around to their heart’s content with bounce zones, obstacle courses and slides. You can also expect cheerful music and plenty of photo ops.

events.title: Festival at Mount Si
events.loc: Si View Park , 400 S.E. Orchard Dr., North Bend
events.desc: Festival season is still in full swing, and this is one you won’t want to miss. There are three full days of festivities, from Friday night’s music crawl to Saturday’s parade and Sunday’s family fun-centered activities. You can expect a bounce house, food trucks, pickleball and more. Pro tip: Don’t miss The Harmonica Pocket onstage Saturday afternoon.

events.title: Edmonds Block Party
events.loc: Civic Center Playfield , 310 Sixth Ave. N., Edmonds
events.desc: This epic block party is back for its second year with an expanded family zone on Saturday. The kids will love the mini golf, bounce houses, gem mining and story time, along with carefully curated DJ sets. Grab lunch from one of the food booths — dumplings, fruit skewers, crepes and more will be on offer. (Psst, parents … If you can arrange for a babysitter, Saturday night’s lineup brings music…

events.title: National Bowling Day at Secoma Lanes
events.loc: Secoma Lanes , 34500 Pacific Hwy. S., Federal Way
events.desc: I’ll be honest: I didn’t know National Bowling Day was a holiday. But there’s no better day to bowl! Enjoy free games, multiple bounce houses and cornhole at this fun community fest. There will also be balloon twisting, face painting and meal deals.

events.title: Nia Fest
events.desc: Celebrate Black culture and community at this free fest with youth-focused activities. From an epic jump rope show to a basketball tournament, there will be plenty of entertainment. Plus, kids can make slime and other crafts.

events.title: Glass Fest Northwest
events.loc: Museum of Glass , 1801 Dock St., Tacoma
events.desc: There is something so mesmerizing about glassmaking. Watch live demonstrations during this annual fest, where you can also shop artist booths and take part in hands-on activities. Plus, museum admission is free for the day, making it easy to pop inside and see more incredible artwork!

events.title: Waterpalooza at Pratt Spray Park
events.desc: If you’re hoping to cool off this weekend, this is the place to be. A fantastic spray park transforms into a full-on water extravaganza with water games, special activities and more. Grab your swimsuit, water shoes, towels and sunscreen, and splash on.

events.title: Ananda Mela – Joyful Festival of India
events.loc: Redmond City Hall , 15670 N.E. 85th St., Redmond
events.desc: Join 20,000 other community members this weekend at a fantastic celebration of Indian culture and arts. Experience incredible performances and demonstrations, try delicious food, and shop for unique clothing, accessories and more. There will also be hands-on activities, including butter churning and conch shell blowing.

events.title: Moomin Day at the Museum
events.cost: Included with admission ($10–20) or membership; ages 4 and younger are free
events.loc: National Nordic Museum , 2655 N.W. Market St., Seattle
events.desc: I absolutely love the Moomins. These trolls from Tove Jansson’s charming stories live in a whimsical world, and the National Nordic Museum brings it all to life with a special exhibition you won’t want to miss. This weekend brings fun children’s activities to the museum, including Moomin face painting, crafts, and movies playing on the big screen.
